blurb.randomGroups: The {{who}} are shuffled and spread evenly across the groups.
blurb.randomBracket: The {{who}} are shuffled into the bracket. One tap, nothing to set up.
blurb.manualGroups: You fill every group sheet yourself.
blurb.manualBracket: You place every entrant yourself — pick the pairings and who gets a bye.
blurb.seededGroups: Registration order snakes across the groups, so the early joiners are split up.
blurb.seededBracket: Registration order is the ranking: #1 v #N, #2 v #N-1 … and the top seeds take the byes.
blurb.pots: Sort the {{who}} into {{count}} pots — each group draws one name out of every pot.

groupNeedsTwo: Group {{group}} needs at least 2 — a one-entrant group never plays.
matchEmpty: Match {{match}} is empty — spread the byes out so every match has someone in it.
payloadBroken: The entrant list came back incomplete. Pull to refresh and open the draw again.
needTwoEntrants: A bracket needs at least 2 {{noun}} — there
howDecided: How should the opening fixtures be decided?
tapPot: Tap a pot to fill it
tapGroup: Tap a group to fill it
tapSpot: Tap a spot to put someone in it
confirmTailBracket: — after this you can only swap two positions.
confirmNotice: Everyone registered gets a notification and the tournament goes live. The draw cannot be re-run afterwards
